facts: The Alvarez Family Trust conveyed a residential parcel out of the trust to the settlor's son, who occupies it. No commercial use follows the conveyance. The parcel is classified as residential real property under MCL 211.34c. The deed was recorded in March 2026.

expected.notes: 27a(7)(v) — conveyance FROM a trust to an enumerated relative. Different subdivision from (g); tests that the model distinguishes into-trust from out-of-trust. [FACTS TIGHTENED 2026-08-04, systematic audit: the statute defines 'residential real property' as property CLASSIFIED as such under section 34c, and the family/trust exceptions in (7)(u), (7)(g)(ii) and (7)(v) all begin 'Beginning December 31, 2014'. Cases that said only 'residential parcel' with no date left the model unable to tell (7)(t) from (7)(u) — which is what made TD-FAMRES-003 fail before it was fixed the same way. Classification and a transfer date are now stated wherever they are load-bearing. The legal question each case tests is unchanged.]
